Cancel a job.

## Synopsis

```text
cancel [storage=<storage>] [sd=<sd>] [jobid=<jobid>[,...]] [job=<job>]
       [ujobid=<ujobid>] [state=<state>] [all] [yes]
```

Words without brackets are required, `[ ]` marks optional parts, `a | b` alternatives, `...` a repeatable argument and `[,...]` a comma separated list.

## Description

Cancels running or waiting jobs; without a selection the Director asks for one.

## Arguments {#arguments}

| Argument | Type | Values / source | Default | Flags | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `storage=` | resource | from [`.storages`](../dot-storage/) |  |  | Jobs of a storage. |
| `sd=` | resource | from [`.storages`](../dot-storage/) |  |  | Storage name (as storage=). |
| `jobid=` | string |  |  | list | Job ID. |
| `job=` | resource | from [`.jobs`](../dot-jobs/) |  |  | Job name. |
| `ujobid=` | string |  |  |  | Unique job name. |
| `state=` | string |  |  |  | Jobs in this state (created, blocked, waiting, running). |
| `all` | keyword |  |  |  | Every job. |
| `yes` | keyword |  |  |  | Do not ask. |

## Examples

Cancel job 42 after confirmation:

```text
cancel jobid=42
```

Cancel the running BackupClient1 job without asking:

```text
cancel job=BackupClient1 yes
```

Cancel every waiting job:

```text
cancel state=waiting yes
```
